calculate_elastic_properties: calculate elastic tensor, shear modulus, and bulk modulus for a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
run_elasticity_with_job_sharding: run elasticity calculations on a subset of structures by specifying job_num and num_jobs for parallel execution
write_elasticity_results_to_json: write elasticity calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a specified results directory
convert_elastic_tensor_to_gpa: convert the elastic tensor from eV/Angstrom^3 to GPa units using the eVA3_to_GPa conversion constant
handle_elasticity_calculation_errors: handle exceptions during elasticity calculations by capturing error messages and tracebacks in the results dictionary
